2608.13043.title: From Local Mismatch to Global Impact: Optimizing Cache Reuse Policy for Efficient Diffusion
2608.13043.paper_summary: Diffusion models have achieved dominant performance in visual generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead. While cache-based acceleration has emerged as a promising solution, existing policies rely on local similarity heuristics, which we identify as being significantly misaligned with final generation quality. This discrepancy stems from the non-uniform propagation and accumulation of errors along the denoising trajectory. To address this, we propose Global-Impact Cache (GCache). We first establish a rigorous theoretical characterization of the error propagation upper bound. Recognizing that this bound can be overly conservative for complex, highly non-convex diffusion models, we further reparameterize the propagation exponent with a Bernstein form and reformulate cache policy search as a bilevel optimization problem. In detail, GCache identifies an optimal reuse policy in the inner objective while aligning the error-weighting function with generation quality loss in the outer objective. This framework effectively reconciles theoretical rigor with empirical performance, learning to prioritize computation where it most impacts visual fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GCache consistently outperforms prior caching strategies on both video and image generation. Notably, on the state-of-the-art Wan2.1 video diffusion model, GCache maintains a 2.17x speedup while significantly enhancing generation quality, reducing LPIPS from 0.1095 to 0.0316.
2608.13043.paper_summary_zh: 擴散模型在視覺生成方面已達到主導性能，但面臨著相當大的推理開銷。雖然基於快取的加速已成為一種有前景的解決方案，但現有政策依賴於局部相似性啟發式，我們認為這與最終生成質量存在顯著不一致。這種差異源於去噪軌跡中錯誤的非均勻傳播和累積。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了全球影響快取（GCache）。我們首先建立了錯誤傳播上界的嚴謹理論特徵。意識到這個上界對於複雜的、高度非凸的擴散模型可能過於保守，我們進一步用伯恩斯坦形式重新參數化傳播指數，並將快取政策搜尋重新表述為雙層優化問題。具體來說，GCache 在內部目標中識別最佳重用政策，同時在外部目標中將錯誤加權函數與生成質量損失對齊。這一框架有效地調和了理論嚴謹性與實證性能，學會在最影響視覺真實性的地方優先計算。大量實驗表明，GCache 在視頻和圖像生成方面始終優於先前的快取策略。值得注意的是，在最先進的 Wan2.1 視頻擴散模型上，GCache 維持了 2.17 倍的加速，同時顯著提高了生成質量，將 LPIPS 從 0.1095 降至 0.0316。
